name: page-section
useFor: Use as the outer wrapper of any website section so pages read as one survey sheet. Pass label, title and intro for the head (title left, intro right on wide screens) and the section's content as children. Pass `closing` on the last section of a page to draw the bottom rule. SECTION_GUTTER, SECTION_COLUMN and SECTION_INSET align anything else (a header) to the rails; SITE_LINK and SiteLockup are the website's link and lockup.
constraints: Sections without the rails on a page that has them
Nodes anywhere but where two rules cross
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): PageRails and page-rails.css (rails at the content edges, rules at section boundaries, nodes at crossings), section-rhythm.css
title: Page section
description: The survey frame every website section sits in: 1px Stone rails at the content edges, a rule edge to edge at the top, a solid Forest diamond at each crossing, an optional mono label, title and intro.
